questions.question: Identify the segment which contains a grammatical error. 'One of my friends are going to the USA.'
questions.explanation: 'One' is a singular subject, so it takes a singular verb. 'Are' should be replaced with 'is'.

hi.question: दिए गए वाक्य के किस भाग में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है? 'One of my friends are going to the USA.'
hi.explanation: 'One' एकवचन कर्ता (singular subject) है, इसलिए इसके साथ 'is' का प्रयोग होना चाहिए, 'are' का नहीं।

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word: TIMID
questions.explanation: Timid means showing a lack of courage or confidence; easily frightened. 'Shy' is the closest synonym.

hi.question: दिए गए शब्द का सही पर्यायवाची (Synonym) चुनें: TIMID
hi.explanation: Timid का अर्थ है डरपोक या संकोची। Shy का अर्थ भी शर्मीला/संकोची है।

questions.question: Select the meaning of the idiom: 'Spill the beans'
questions.explanation: 'Spill the beans' means to reveal secret information unintentionally or indiscreetly.

hi.question: मुहावरे का अर्थ चुनें: 'Spill the beans'
hi.explanation: इसका अर्थ है 'रहस्य उजागर करना' या 'भेद खोल देना'।

questions.question: Fill in the blank: He is good _____ Mathematics.
questions.explanation: We use the preposition 'at' after 'good' to indicate proficiency (e.g., good at sports, good at math).

hi.question: रिक्त स्थान भरें: He is good _____ Mathematics.
hi.explanation: किसी विषय या कौशल में अच्छे होने के लिए 'good at' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

questions.question: Select the antonym of: DILIGENT
questions.explanation: Diligent means hardworking. Lazy is the opposite.

hi.question: विलोम शब्द चुनें: DILIGENT
hi.explanation: Diligent का अर्थ है मेहनती। Lazy का अर्थ है आलसी।

questions.question: One word substitution: 'The scientific study of stars and planets'
questions.explanation: Astronomy is the scientific study of celestial objects. Astrology is about predicting future based on stars.

hi.question: एक शब्द प्रतिस्थापन: 'The scientific study of stars and planets'
hi.explanation: तारों और ग्रहों के वैज्ञानिक अध्ययन को Astronomy (खगोल विज्ञान) कहते हैं।

questions.question: Improve the underlined part: She did not *wrote* the letter.
questions.explanation: After 'did not', we always use the base form of the verb (V1). So, 'write' is correct.

hi.question: वाक्य सुधार: She did not *wrote* the letter.
hi.explanation: 'Did not' के बाद हमेशा verb की पहली फॉर्म (write) आती है।

questions.question: Select the correctly spelt word.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'Separate'.

hi.question: सही वर्तनी चुनें।
hi.explanation: सही स्पेलिंग 'Separate' (अलग) है।

questions.question: Select the synonym of: ENORMOUS
questions.explanation: Enormous means very large in size. Huge is the synonym.

hi.question: समानार्थक शब्द चुनें: ENORMOUS
hi.explanation: Enormous का अर्थ है विशाल। Huge का अर्थ भी विशाल है।

questions.question: Identify the error: 'He is an European citizen.'
questions.explanation: 'European' starts with a consonant sound ('Yoo'), so the article should be 'a', not 'an'.

hi.question: त्रुटि ज्ञात करें: 'He is an European citizen.'
hi.explanation: 'European' का उच्चारण व्यंजन ध्वनि 'यू' (Yoo) से शुरू होता है, इसलिए 'a' का प्रयोग होगा, 'an' का नहीं।

questions.question: Fill in the blank: Hardly had I reached the station _____ the train left.
questions.explanation: The pair is 'Hardly... when' or 'Scarcely... when'. 'No sooner' takes 'than'.

hi.question: रिक्त स्थान भरें: Hardly had I reached the station _____ the train left.
hi.explanation: 'Hardly' के साथ हमेशा 'when' का प्रयोग होता है।

questions.question: One word substitution: 'One who eats everything (both plants and meat)'
questions.explanation: Omnivorous means feeding on food of both plant and animal origin.

hi.question: एक शब्द प्रतिस्थापन: 'One who eats everything (both plants and meat)'
hi.explanation: जो सब कुछ खाता है (मांसाहारी और शाकाहारी दोनों) उसे Omnivorous (सर्वाहारी) कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the correctly spelt word.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'Embarrassment' (double r, double s).

hi.question: सही वर्तनी चुनें।
hi.explanation: सही स्पेलिंग 'Embarrassment' है (दो r, दो s)।

questions.question: Meaning of the idiom: 'A blessing in disguise'

options.B: A bad thing that turns out to be good

questions.explanation: It refers to something that seems bad or unlucky at first, but results in something good happening later.

hi.question: मुहावरे का अर्थ: 'A blessing in disguise'

options.B: A bad thing that turns out to be good

hi.explanation: दुख के भेष में सुख (शुरुआत में बुरा लगे लेकिन अंत में अच्छा हो)।

questions.question: Fill in the blank: I need to buy some _____ for my office.
questions.explanation: 'Stationery' refers to writing materials. 'Stationary' means not moving.

hi.question: रिक्त स्थान भरें (Homophones): I need to buy some _____ for my office.
hi.explanation: लेखन सामग्री को 'Stationery' कहते हैं। 'Stationary' का अर्थ स्थिर होता है।

questions.question: Improve the sentence: He is *senior than* me in service.
questions.explanation: Adjectives ending in '-ior' (senior, junior, superior) take 'to', not 'than'.

hi.question: वाक्य सुधार: He is *senior than* me in service.
hi.explanation: 'Senior', 'Junior', 'Superior' आदि के साथ 'to' का प्रयोग होता है, 'than' का नहीं।

questions.question: Select the antonym of: SHALLOW
questions.explanation: Shallow means of little depth. Deep means extending far down.

hi.question: विलोम शब्द चुनें: SHALLOW
hi.explanation: Shallow का अर्थ है उथला। Deep का अर्थ है गहरा।

questions.question: Identify the error: 'Unless you will study hard, you cannot pass.'
questions.explanation: In a conditional clause starting with 'Unless' or 'If', we do not use the future tense 'will'. Correct: 'Unless you study hard...'

hi.question: त्रुटि ज्ञात करें: 'Unless you will study hard, you cannot pass.'
hi.explanation: 'Unless' या 'If' वाले क्लॉज में future tense (will) का प्रयोग नहीं होता। सही होगा: 'Unless you study hard...'।

questions.question: Fill in the blank: An apple a day keeps the doctor _____.
questions.explanation: The proverb is 'An apple a day keeps the doctor away'.

hi.question: रिक्त स्थान भरें: An apple a day keeps the doctor _____.
hi.explanation: यह एक कहावत है: 'An apple a day keeps the doctor away'।

questions.question: Meaning of the idiom: 'Hit the sack'
questions.explanation: 'Hit the sack' is an informal idiom meaning to go to bed or go to sleep.

hi.question: मुहावरे का अर्थ: 'Hit the sack'
hi.explanation: इसका अर्थ है 'सोने जाना'।

questions.question: One word substitution: 'A place where bees are kept'
questions.explanation: An Apiary is a place where bees are kept. Aviary is for birds.

hi.question: एक शब्द प्रतिस्थापन: 'A place where bees are kept'
hi.explanation: मधुमक्खियों को रखने की जगह को Apiary कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the correctly spelt word.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'Necessary' (one c, double s).

hi.question: सही वर्तनी चुनें।
hi.explanation: सही स्पेलिंग 'Necessary' है।

questions.question: Improve the sentence: I am *looking forward to meet* you.
questions.explanation: The phrase 'look forward to' is always followed by a gerund (verb+ing). Correct: 'looking forward to meeting'.

hi.question: वाक्य सुधार: I am *looking forward to meet* you.
hi.explanation: 'Look forward to' के बाद हमेशा Gerund (verb+ing) का प्रयोग होता है। सही है: 'meeting'।

questions.question: Select the synonym of: LETHARGIC
questions.explanation: Lethargic means sluggish or lazy.

hi.question: समानार्थक शब्द चुनें: LETHARGIC
hi.explanation: Lethargic का अर्थ है सुस्त या आलसी।

questions.question: Fill in the blank: The sun _____ in the east.
questions.explanation: Universal truths are always written in Simple Present Tense. 'Sun' is singular, so 'rises'.

hi.question: रिक्त स्थान भरें: The sun _____ in the east.
hi.explanation: सार्वभौमिक सत्य (Universal truth) के लिए Present Indefinite Tense का प्रयोग होता है। Sun एकवचन है, इसलिए 'rises' आएगा।
